reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is mobile access integration for DeepSeek Harness: it adds a phone connection UI in the web settings row and enables phone pairing plus LAN-based mobile client use via an internal bridge, so it best fits the Desktop & Mobile category. Its exposed behavior centers on connectivity and session/chat interaction rather than coding, analytics, or external automation control.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在网页设置区域提供手机连接入口并支持二维码配对，从而在局域网内访问 DSH 移动端客户端。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness plugin adds a phone connection entry in the web UI and enables QR-based pairing to a local bridge so a phone can use the DSH mobile client over LAN.

capabilities: hosts a LAN HTTP bridge for phone pairing and mobile access
supports QR-based desktop-approved pairing with token lifecycle
provides a mobile DSH web client for sessions and prompts
forwards only an allowlisted set of RPC calls to harness endpoints
injects web UI elements for phone connection state and management

reasons.code: Plugin serves a separate LAN bridge (`lan-bridge.mjs`) with pairing, mobile client, and RPC forwarding behavior described in README documentation.
Readme explicitly lists only allowlisted RPC methods (`workspace.list`, `session.list`, `session.history`, `session.create`, `session.prompt`, `session.cancel`) for bridge forwarding.
Repository layout includes `lib/index.js`, `lib/client.js`, `lan-bridge.mjs`, and `pages.mjs`, indicating host/plugin logic plus browser-side integration for pairing/settings UI.
Manifested package setup (`dsh.bundle.patch`, web client export) shows the plugin is a DSH web-profile extension rather than a standalone app.
